note: The survey only says its results will inform the next iteration of the NSDS; no adoption, drafting, review or evaluation is stated with a date or period.

facts.fact: The document, signed at Monrovia on 15 December 2025, presents the launch of Liberia's third-generation NSDS III for 2026-2030 as its Foreword states, though chapter 6 also says activities proceed once the LISGIS Board approves it.
The first strategy, NSDS I 2008-2013, is stated as having guided post-war recovery of the statistical system; that period has ended.

note: NSDS II is stated not implemented, with a period extended to 2026 and no end stated, so no fact; the annual reviews and mid-term (2028) and endline (2030) evaluations of NSDS III are only planned.

facts.fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists a strategy as being designed or awaiting adoption: national strategy for the development of statistics.

facts.fact: LISGIS officially launched the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics at an event on 18 February 2026, per its Director General.
UNFPA Liberia advertised a 60-working-day consultancy, beginning the first week of May 2025, to draft and validate a new NSDS for LISGIS in line with the 2025-2029 development plan.
LISGIS Director-General-designate Richard Ngafuan told the Senate that the NSDS in force from 2008 expired in 2013 and no approved strategy has governed the statistical system since.
